_comment: Sister levels (docs/PERSISTENT_RPG_DESIGN.md §Levels). Each sister earns XP from the fights she wins and from completed missions; missions are gated by the party level (the rounded-down average of the sisters' levels). Every level adds hp_per_level Max HP; milestone levels add the rewards listed. At dual_specialization_level a sister may take a second card specialization (any of hers; it is learned for free). Her look always follows her primary specialization.

xp.note: Fight XP is earned per fight won (elite and boss rooms pay more); the mission bonus (difficulty x mission_per_difficulty) only on completion. Defeat keeps half.
